headline: Mexico-Canada Merchandise Trade Rises Over 18% Through August
summary: Bilateral merchandise trade between Mexico and Canada reached 34.42 billion Canadian dollars in the first eight months of the year, up 18.3% year-over-year.
why: Cross-border trade volumes reflect regional economic integration and supply chain activity under North American trade frameworks.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Bilateral trade growth reflects expanding economic activity between Mexico and Canada.
